manage.title: Temporary share links
manage.intro: Send somebody a link that shows this tracker for a set period, without giving them an account. Every link is guarded by a code as well, so a forwarded message is not enough on its own.
manage.loadFailed: Could not load the share links.
manage.noPermission: You need sharing rights on this device to create share links.

form.createFailed: Could not create the share link.
form.editNotice: The link and its code do not change, so whoever already has them keeps access. Changing the period also changes which positions they can see — moving the start earlier reveals older history to them.
form.extrasHint: Both are off unless you turn them on. Neither says anything about where the vehicle is.
form.labelField: What the recipient sees this called
form.labelHint: Optional. Left empty, the device's own name is used. This is the only name the recipient ever learns — they never see the device id.
form.scopeLatestHint: One pin, refreshing. No route and no history.
form.scopeTrack: The whole track for the period
form.scopeTrackHint: Every recorded position between the two times.

created.channelAdvice: Send the code a different way from the link — say it on the phone, or in another app. Two secrets in one message is one secret.
created.reissuedWarning: Shown once, like before. The previous link and code no longer work — send these to whoever should still have access.
created.title: Share link created
created.warning: Shown once. Neither the link nor the code can be recovered — if you lose them, revoke this link and create another.

row.confirmReissue: Generate a new link and code?
row.confirmReissueHint: The link and code cannot be shown again — they are only stored as hashes, so nobody can read them back. Generating new ones is the only way to recover access. The previous link and code stop working immediately, so anyone using this share now will lose it until you send them the new pair.
row.confirmRevokeHint: It stops working immediately, for anybody currently using it.
row.failedAttempts_one: {{count}} wrong code since the last success
row.failedAttempts_other: {{count}} wrong codes since the last success
row.reissueFailed: Could not generate a new link and code.
row.revokedNotEditable: A revoked link cannot be changed. Create a new one instead.

visitor.prompt: Enter the access code you were given.
visitor.invalidLink: This link is not valid. Check that you opened the whole address you were sent.
visitor.needsOriginalLink: Open the original link you were sent to view this again.
visitor.expiredSession: This share is no longer available.
visitor.fullTrack: Showing the recorded track for this period.
visitor.noPositions: No positions recorded for this period yet.
visitor.loadFailed: Could not load the shared positions.
visitor.privacyNote: You are seeing this because somebody shared it with you for a limited time. Nothing about you is recorded.
